Each figure of the paper is produced by one script in `figures_manuscript/` at its printed size, styled by [`fluxpy.figstyle`](../api/fluxpy.figstyle.md) (one font size, one colour per flux estimate). The pages show each figure with its caption from the paper, its construction, the code it depends on and the script itself. `pixi run figures` rebuilds all figures (about 3 minutes; Figures 1, 4 and 5 download map data once).
